- Keyword Optimization for DevOps Engineer roles
- Resume Format & Structure for IT positions
- LinkedIn Profile Optimization — headline summary skills
- Naukri Profile Update — keywords and visibility
- Portfolio Projects Presentation in resume
- Interview Preparation Strategy overview

concepts.title: Key learnings
concepts.text_md:
- ATS rejects 75 percent of resumes before any human sees them — keyword optimization is critical
- LinkedIn headline formula: Senior DevOps Engineer and AWS and GCP and Kubernetes
- Quantify everything: Reduced deployment time by 60 percent beats Improved deployment
- GitHub repo link on resume equals proof of skills — more powerful than any certification
- Your resume should tell the story of business impact not just a list of job descriptions
